scope: Proposed ACT house buyer risk and opportunity signals; no live scores, model outputs or working integrations implied.

phase_definitions.V0 core: Core ACT-house screening and buyer evidence requirements.
phase_definitions.V1 extended: Additional core analysis after suitable accessible/document evidence and adapter validation.
phase_definitions.V2 optional: Optional extensions requiring further access, geometry, calibration or specialist evidence.

source_notes.BUYER: Declared buyer inputs and authorised transaction/specialist documents. Provenance and permission must be recorded.
source_notes.R01: RBA cash target CSV (root source register).
source_notes.R02: RBA housing lending rates CSV (root source register).
source_notes.R03: Commercial Cotality property transactions API documentation only; access and actual records not established.
source_notes.R04: Public ACT aggregate rental bond PDFs; not a property rent or vacancy feed.
source_notes.empty_source_ids: System-derived evidence-quality signal applied to all ingested records; no additional external source asserted.

rule_link_note: Links use the rule IDs and meanings in architecture_body.md. A linked rule applies only when its own prerequisites and condition are met.

signals.grain_units: One property; identifiers and match status
signals.processing: Normalise address; reconcile address/parcel links and aliases; require unambiguous entity before dependent joins.
signals.output: Confirmed identity or explicit ambiguity with candidate matches.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold dependent findings; request address/plan confirmation.

signals.grain_units: Property and ownership scheme; category
signals.processing: Distinguish detached house, unit-title house and apartment; keep dwelling form separate from legal ownership.
signals.output: Correct applicable modules, including shared-property records when relevant.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Mark ownership form unresolved; do not assume detached appearance means standalone title.

signals.grain_units: Building polygon; metres and attribution status
signals.processing: Link the actual dwelling to its parcel; separate sheds, garages, roof outline and habitable footprint.
signals.output: Verified or qualified dwelling geometry for exposure checks.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Use parcel-level screening only and label building-level exposure unknown.

signals.grain_units: Boundary geometry; positional tolerance in metres
signals.processing: Compare mapping with authoritative plans; record positional uncertainty and resolve material mismatches.
signals.output: Boundary confidence and need for survey review.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not give exact boundary-distance conclusions without adequate geometry.

signals.grain_units: Parcel/building; intersection area m² and proportion %
signals.processing: Intersect valid geometry under the documented CRS; distinguish positive-area overlap, boundary touch, non-overlap and indeterminate alignment; report parcel and dwelling findings separately.
signals.output: Mapped exposure to the stated event, without claiming damage probability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If model coverage or identity is uncertain, report not assessed rather than no flood risk.

signals.grain_units: Boundary relation; distance/tolerance metres
signals.processing: Assess whether mapping uncertainty could change the intersection result; use evidence-based tolerances.
signals.output: Boundary-sensitive finding requiring more precise evidence.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold definitive inside/outside conclusion where tolerance is unknown or material.

raw_inputs: Numerical flood model or specialist report
signals.grain_units: Dwelling/location; metres only with numeric evidence
signals.processing: Use validated numerical data or a scoped report; never convert map tile colours into exact depths.
signals.output: Documented depth/range or map-only context.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Keep depth unknown until numerical model/report and datum are available.

signals.grain_units: Property/component; categorical findings and repair evidence
signals.processing: Extract observed drainage defects and scope; distinguish stormwater/overland flow from mapped river flooding.
signals.output: Drainage issue, affected areas and next inspection or repair step.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No riverine map intersection does not clear drainage risk; request inspection.

signals.grain_units: Parcel/nearby terrain; slope degrees and elevation metres
signals.processing: Derive terrain context at supported resolution; check age and alterations; do not infer water depth.
signals.output: Potential drainage investigation trigger with terrain limitations.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Mark terrain analysis unavailable or stale; no invented flow path.

signals.grain_units: Dwelling; vertical difference metres
signals.processing: Calculate clearance only where level definitions, datum and event align.
signals.output: Evidence-backed floor clearance/range for the specified scenario.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold calculation if either level or datum is missing; ground elevation is insufficient.

signals.grain_units: Parcel; mapped category and intersection
signals.processing: Intersect the correct designation layer and retain its category/date; boundary-only or uncertain alignment creates a review gap rather than a definitive designation finding.
signals.output: Official designation requiring building and insurance follow-up.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing layer/coverage is not absence of fire exposure.

signals.grain_units: Property/building; assessment category and observed measures
signals.processing: Separate official area designation from site-specific assessment and mitigation evidence.
signals.output: Verified resilience limitations and required specialist checks.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not derive BAL or loss probability from the area map alone.

signals.grain_units: Site/structure; qualitative finding and documented measurements
signals.processing: Extract verified soil/ground findings and their scope; link structural observations without diagnosing from imagery.
signals.output: Ground/retaining risk requiring specialist assessment or quoted remedy.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown without suitable report; slope or nearby cracks alone do not establish subsidence.

signals.grain_units: Site/parcel; status and dated obligations
signals.processing: Reconcile parcel aliases and current/historical records; preserve remediation conditions.
signals.output: Known contamination/history, restrictions and unresolved search gaps.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No register match does not clear contamination; request formal search where material.

signals.signal_name: Loose-fill asbestos history and other asbestos evidence
signals.grain_units: Property/material; known history and inspection scope
signals.processing: Match current and historical addresses; retain deregistered history; keep other asbestos assessment separate.
signals.output: Known loose-fill history and independent material-assessment status.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Negative register match does not prove no asbestos or no undiscovered loose fill.

signals.signal_name: Future heat, rainfall and fire-weather context
signals.grain_units: Regional grid; native units and scenario period
signals.processing: Summarise model scenarios and ensemble range at supported geography; align horizon with buyer holding period.
signals.output: Conditional regional climate context, separate from measured current hazards.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If access/model metadata is missing, keep future quantitative claims unavailable.

signals.signal_name: Title or lease conflict with intended use
signals.grain_units: Property/title; verified restriction and buyer requirement
signals.processing: Extract restrictions with source pages; compare with explicit intended use; flag for professional interpretation.
signals.output: Documented buyer-use conflict or unresolved legal question.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No title/lease means legal fit incomplete; do not clear intended use.

signals.grain_units: Parcel/instrument; category and extent where verified
signals.processing: Link registered instruments to affected land and intended works without inventing easement geometry.
signals.output: Material building/access constraint and verification action.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown scope stays unresolved until instrument/plan review.

signals.signal_name: Current zoning and statutory development controls
signals.grain_units: Parcel/policy; current and applicable legal version
signals.processing: Combine spatial zone with legal provisions; distinguish current entitlement from proposed change.
signals.output: Supported development constraints or requirement conflict.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Map zone alone cannot establish permission; hold conclusion when legal controls are absent.

signals.grain_units: Building/alteration; approved versus observed status
signals.processing: Compare authorised documents with observed built form; treat discrepancies as verification triggers.
signals.output: Potential unapproved work or missing completion evidence.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Absence of a retrieved plan is not proof of illegal work; request records.

signals.grain_units: Building/component; documented defect severity
signals.processing: Extract actual findings with page references and inspector qualifications; preserve inaccessible areas.
signals.output: Material defect, uncertainty and scoped follow-up.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No inspection or inaccessible component remains not assessed.

signals.grain_units: Component; observed defect and date
signals.processing: Separate observed moisture from suspected causes; retain test limits and repair evidence.
signals.output: Water-ingress finding and investigation/repair need.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Photos alone cannot clear concealed damage; request targeted inspection.

signals.grain_units: Building/site; activity/history and assessment scope
signals.processing: Extract current activity, damage and prevention evidence without treating past treatment as clearance.
signals.output: Pest concern and further assessment or maintenance need.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing/incomplete inspection means pest condition unknown.

signals.grain_units: Property/component; AUD range and timing
signals.processing: Separate urgent repairs from lifecycle maintenance; use documented quotations or labelled estimates and avoid duplicate work items.
signals.output: Upfront/near-term cost range and unresolved cost exposure.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unpriced material defects remain material uncertainty; do not enter zero cost.

signals.grain_units: Quote/property; coverage categories and expiry
signals.processing: Compare reviewed policy terms with buyer requirements; distinguish one refusal from market-wide insurability.
signals.output: Cover conflict, suitable reviewed offer or evidence gap within stated quote scope.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Insurability unknown without current suitable evidence; never infer from hazard map alone.

signals.grain_units: Quote; AUD/year and AUD excess
signals.processing: Compare only materially similar cover/input combinations; retain quote validity and unpriced exclusions.
signals.output: Annual ownership-cost input and conditional premium comparison.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No generic suburb premium substituted for actual quote; show missing cost.

signals.grain_units: Property/policy; AUD amounts and documented ratio
signals.processing: Compare like-for-like rebuild scope; keep land value and market price out of rebuild-cost basis.
signals.output: Possible underinsurance and coverage-scope gaps.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No rebuild estimate means adequacy unknown; sale price is not a replacement.

signals.grain_units: Scheme/unit; documented issue and liability basis
signals.processing: Activate for applicable shared-title houses/units; link shared defects to unit exposure without assuming liability amounts.
signals.output: Shared-building issue and document/professional review need.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing required scheme records means assessment incomplete, even if detached-house appearance.

signals.grain_units: Scheme/unit; AUD balances, levies and dated commitments
signals.processing: Compare planned works with funds and documented obligations; distinguish current levy from adequate future funding.
signals.output: Known special levy/cash requirement and unfunded-work concern.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Low levies alone are not positive evidence; unresolved funding stays unknown.

signals.grain_units: Canonical project/stage; status, distance and direction
signals.processing: Deduplicate application versions; match relevant land and actual proposal scope; separate approved from constructed.
signals.output: Nearby development fact with status and affected buyer interests.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No retrieved DA does not establish no future or exempt development.

signals.signal_name: Potential sunlight, outlook and privacy change
signals.grain_units: Dwelling/proposal; qualitative impact or verified hours/geometry
signals.processing: Use verified geometry/modelling where available; flag a relevant northern proposal without inventing lost sunlight hours.
signals.output: Amenity finding with modelled versus unverified effects separated.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Keep daylight/privacy impact unresolved if geometry, orientation or plan quality is insufficient.

signals.grain_units: Amendment/site; lifecycle and effective date
signals.processing: Link draft and final instruments; distinguish consultation, interim effect, approval and commencement.
signals.output: Upcoming/current control change and relevance to property.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not apply proposed permissions as current law; unresolved status labelled.

signals.grain_units: Site/precinct/district; indicative year and yield
signals.processing: Identify nearby prospective change; compare annual plans for deferrals and scope revisions.
signals.output: Longer-term growth context with indicative status.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unmapped/uncertain proposals remain regional context; no promised delivery.

signals.grain_units: Project/stage; separate milestone states and date ranges
signals.processing: Maintain parallel lifecycle dimensions; link aliases and superseded notices; detect deferral/cancellation.
signals.output: Evidence-backed delivery status and timing uncertainty.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing milestone evidence remains unknown; announcement is not commitment or completion.

signals.grain_units: Buyer journey/project; minutes only with suitable route/service inputs
signals.processing: Compare usable access/travel scenarios using documented assumptions; account for barriers, transfers and horizon.
signals.output: Conditional opportunity linked to buyer use, without price uplift or risk offset.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If routing or service assumptions lack support, describe qualitative potential only.

signals.signal_name: Construction disruption and operating amenity impacts
signals.grain_units: Property/route/project; duration and documented effect
signals.processing: Separate temporary works from ongoing operation; cite relevant plans and evidence scope.
signals.output: Disruption timeline and documented amenity/access issue.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not invent noise levels or traffic counts from distance alone.

signals.grain_units: Comparable segment/area/horizon; net dwellings by stage
signals.processing: Link repeated project records; subtract known removals; report proposed/approved/commenced/completed separately.
signals.output: Conditional competing-supply scenario with coverage and timing uncertainty.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unverified completion remains unverified; no double counting or oversupply declaration.

signals.grain_units: SA2/segment; approvals per 100 comparable dwellings over stated period
signals.processing: Align boundaries/type/time; use rolling totals and label stock age; do not treat approvals as delivery.
signals.output: Recent approval pressure relative to appropriate stock.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Suppress ratio when denominator/type match is inadequate; show raw contextual counts.

signals.grain_units: ACT or supported region; dwellings, months and published rates
signals.processing: Assess regional pipeline progression using actual series definitions and revisions.
signals.output: Regional delivery context informing scenario ranges.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No suburb completion estimates fabricated from ACT totals.

signals.signal_name: Evidence for scarcity versus low turnover
signals.grain_units: Comparable market; stock, listings and turnover over explicit period
signals.processing: Distinguish structural constraints, few listings and low transaction activity; assess nearby substitutes.
signals.output: Supported scarcity factors and counter-evidence, without automatic growth claim.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not declare shortage when current listings, demand or stock coverage is absent.

signals.grain_units: SA2/region; people and annual percentage change
signals.processing: Use consistent boundaries and multi-year change; retain preliminary/revised status and observation age.
signals.output: Regional demand context, not a property-price forecast.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not present annual lagged population as current-month observation.

signals.grain_units: Supported region/scenario; households over horizon
signals.processing: Compare future population divided by assumed household size with baseline; retain scenario source and uncertainty.
signals.output: Conditional household-demand range aligned with supply horizon.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not downscale regional projections to suburbs without an explicit validated method.

signals.grain_units: SA2/ACT and buyer context; % and category
signals.processing: Separate modelled local unemployment from observed regional employment; use smoothed/year-on-year context and concentration.
signals.output: Employment-related demand/resilience context at true data geography.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not derive employment from SALM or treat local industry mix as individual income certainty.

signals.grain_units: Comparable sale/property; AUD and evidence age
signals.processing: Select comparable settled sales with explicit exclusions, differences and sample size; verify rights/access first.
signals.output: Comparable set and evidence quality for valuation review.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Documentation-only API access supplies no prices; missing transactions means valuation unavailable.

signals.grain_units: Property; AUD range and relative position
signals.processing: Use a transparent supported comparison range; avoid treating asking price or model estimate as ground truth.
signals.output: Price position and material uncertainty, not guaranteed fair value.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Withhold precise premium/discount if comparables or adjustments are inadequate.

signals.grain_units: Comparable market; turnover, count and supported marketing durations
signals.processing: Measure turnover on matching geography/type; use time-on-market only from genuine listing observations.
signals.output: Resale liquidity context with sample size and data limits.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Sale dates alone do not establish time-on-market; no hidden listing API assumed.

signals.grain_units: Property versus ACT aggregate; AUD/week/month and period
signals.processing: Keep property evidence separate from regional bond context; calculate net rental scenarios only with declared costs.
signals.output: Supported rent range/context and conditional net-income scenario.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: ACT aggregates do not prove suburb/property rent or vacancy; missing property evidence stays unknown.

signals.grain_units: Suburb/region; counts and rates with denominator/year
signals.processing: Use multi-period trends, small-count caution and commercial/residential context; preserve revisions.
signals.output: Neighbourhood offence context without address-level victimisation probability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Stale/missing crime data is unknown, not zero; suppress unstable unsupported rate claims.

signals.grain_units: Property/school/year; eligibility category
signals.processing: Check address and year against official PEA; record shared-zone caveats and announced changes.
signals.output: Eligible-school evidence and requirement fit.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not infer eligibility from proximity or guarantee preferred school in a shared zone.

signals.grain_units: Journey/time period; services/hour and supported travel minutes
signals.processing: Assess scheduled usefulness for relevant days/times; keep walking-network and reliability evidence separate.
signals.output: Usable-service profile and commute/access constraints.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Without approved feed/routing access use dated timetable/manual evidence; no invented travel times.

signals.grain_units: Road/intersection/route; reported counts and spatial relation
signals.processing: Aggregate appropriate multi-year observations near actual access routes; flag approximate points and exposure limits.
signals.output: Route-related investigation prompt, not personal collision probability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No crash/traffic exposure data means context incomplete; distance alone cannot quantify risk.

signals.grain_units: Dwelling; native rating scale and assessment date
signals.processing: Verify report/method; keep envelope, Whole of Home and actual bills distinct; assess currency.
signals.output: Supported energy/comfort evidence and upgrade questions.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Listing stars without source remain unverified; no conversion between incompatible scales.

signals.grain_units: Suburb/region or verified local context; canopy %
signals.processing: Retain actual survey vintage and height definition; distinguish area canopy from property shade.
signals.output: Dated canopy context and limited-shade investigation trigger.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not infer house temperatures, exact shade hours or young-tree absence from regional canopy.

signals.grain_units: Property/location/time; units only from actual assessment
signals.processing: Record measured and self-reported evidence separately; preserve sampling limits and source competence.
signals.output: Evidence-backed amenity concern or explicit measurement gap.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: No verified public noise/air adapter in source set; do not infer levels from traffic, canopy or distance.

signals.signal_name: Macro rates and actual borrowing terms
signals.grain_units: National series and actual loan; annual % with dates
signals.processing: Show macro context separately from contractual buyer rate; retain product and fixation dates.
signals.output: Rate context and actual starting assumptions for cash-flow scenarios.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Cash target is not the buyer mortgage rate; no offer means declared scenario only.

signals.grain_units: Buyer/property; AUD/month
signals.processing: Calculate appropriate repayment schedule and complete monthly cash flow; keep assumptions visible and avoid counting principal twice.
signals.output: Baseline surplus/deficit with input completeness.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Incomplete costs/income cannot produce a definitive pass; record missing inputs.

raw_inputs: Scenario start and duration in months
signals.grain_units: Buyer/scenario; rate percentage points and AUD/month
signals.processing: Apply disclosed stress increments to relevant loan periods over the named duration; calculate monthly cash balances and assess any reserve breach within that horizon.
signals.output: Conditional resilience result, not a predicted interest-rate path.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If loan terms or reserve policy are missing, withhold pass/fail and request values.

signals.grain_units: Buyer/scenario; AUD and months
signals.processing: Simulate declared duration/amount of income loss with accessible cash only; reflect fixed obligations.
signals.output: Time-to-reserve-breach and scenario trade-offs.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not assume redraw/credit is available cash without evidence; show incomplete scenario.

signals.grain_units: Property/buyer; AUD/month/year and one-off AUD
signals.processing: Separate recurring, upfront and contingent costs; align timing; exclude duplicate repair/levy entries.
signals.output: Transparent ownership-cost schedule feeding affordability.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unquoted material costs remain a range or unresolved gap, never zero.

signals.grain_units: Buyer/scenario/horizon; AUD equity and cash shortfall
signals.processing: Deferred from V0. A later exit module applies explicit price scenarios, calculates outstanding loan principal at sale from the repayment schedule and deducts sale/exit costs; no forecast probabilities are implied.
signals.output: Conditional exit shortfall; requires a separately specified future exit rule and explicit tax treatment.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Without balance/cost assumptions show incomplete; API documentation alone is not a valuation.

signals.grain_units: Every evidence item; dates and age
signals.processing: Evaluate freshness against native publication cadence and decision needs; separate old observation from recent retrieval.
signals.output: Fresh/current-for-purpose, stale or unverified status with dates.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Unknown dates become an evidence gap; never label retrieved-today data current automatically.

signals.grain_units: Finding/domain; coverage categories and conflict status
signals.processing: Track supported versus uncovered questions; preserve conflicting evidence and superseded versions; review material disagreements.
signals.output: Assessment completeness and explicit unresolved contradictions.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not convert missing values to safe values or average contradictions into certainty.

signals.grain_units: Property/event; change type and timestamps
signals.processing: Distinguish real-world change, source correction and retrieval change; deduplicate repeated notices.
signals.output: Auditable alert stating what changed and which finding needs review.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: If previous snapshot/coverage is absent, identify first observation rather than a new event.

signals.grain_units: Buyer brief/version; categories and explicit thresholds
signals.processing: Capture declared requirements and apply relevant modules; keep subjective preferences separate from factual hazards.
signals.output: Personalised relevance, confirmed conflicts and outstanding buyer requirements.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Do not assume preferences or tolerances; use visible defaults only as unconfirmed scenario inputs.

raw_inputs: Confirmed applicable loan funds, conditions and dates
signals.grain_units: Purchase configuration and funding date; AUD
signals.processing: Sum price, known acquisition costs and committed immediate works; subtract confirmed applicable loan and purchase cash. Preserve separate reserve allocation and unconfirmed funding conditions.
signals.output: Confirmed funding gap or no gap within complete supported scope; provisional estimate where funding is not confirmed.
signals.missing_evidence_handling: Missing costs or unconfirmed funds prevent a fully funded conclusion; create a funding-evidence gap.

delivery_note: V0 core, V1 extended and V2 optional are design priorities, separate from implementation Stages0–6. Source availability is independently recorded. All rows are specifications, not live calculated values.
